verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair question for a compliance case-management SaaS like Hummingbird, but nothing in the evidence documents retention policies, retention periods or deletion controls. The cited items cover data export (one-click case download, CSV table export, report history export), audit trails and file renaming, which are adjacent features and do not deliver retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
